parameters.content:
## Federal Contracts Feed (SAM.gov + Grants.gov)
New US federal contract and grant notices from SAM.gov and Grants.gov in one feed.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/govcon-opportunity-feed

Edit the JSON body to change the input, then connect the output to Google Sheets, Slack, Airtable or email.
